Mumbai BMC Slum Demolition Faces Corporator Opposition

Mumbai's Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) is facing opposition from corporators across parties regarding its proposed 14-foot slum demolition drive. During a standing committee meeting on Wednesday, corporators objected to the action, demanding consultation and questioning the basis for selecting structures for demolition. They urged the administration to roll back the proposed action.
